notes.title: v0.9 Major Update
notes.content:
0.9 Major Update Now Live! Alchemy and New Systems Bring Deep Equipment Customization

Hello~

The 0.9 major update for our game is now available! This update brings a series of exciting new features and improvements, taking your gaming experience to the next level.

Alchemy Returns: The much-requested Alchemy system is back in the game, making your growth limitless!

Mysterious Character:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43307060/c9172cada6b852e9cd4a0443a620db17f8442865.png[/img]

New Equipment System:

Reforging: Now, you can reset the traits of your equipment to ensure every piece is at its best.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43307060/b1554ca098ecdfe4b059a999016c58f87802c8a5.png[/img]
Forging: Use materials to freely choose the parts and grades of your equipment, creating powerful gear tailored for you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43307060/c9c682240694e40b33da8b628a5c092a4090587d.png[/img]
Inlay: Use soul stones and tokens to add new traits to your equipment, unlocking endless possibilities.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43307060/5bd3f256a8f43e1f8483bf914c5297a6f5637034.png[/img]
This update not only enriches the equipment system but also brings more customization options to the game. Now, you can flexibly mix and match equipment to create weapons and armor that truly suit your playstyle.

We have always been committed to enhancing the gaming experience, and now all systems in our game are complete. The next major update, 0.95, will push the main storyline to its final chapter. Thank you for your support and companionship. Let's explore the brand-new world of version 0.9 together!

Happy gaming,
[Bandage Dog Team]

notes.title: 0.85 Update

notes.title: 0.68 Update and Update Plan
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We've rolled out a major update this time, revamping the game's structure and recreating the world map, the entire UI, and introducing a set system. There's a ton of new content, so allow me to break it down for you:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43307060/393dec53e2e2e346cd8d1d6d5ac2ed70564f1e03.png[/img]

[h3]Larger and More Strategic World Map[/h3]
You can now view other factions on the world map and attack and capture points to obtain unique team bonuses. More of these will be unlocked with increasing control points over time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43307060/adddc48f57f83e807b1291ceedcbb5cf38972f74.png[/img]

[h3]Night Parade of One Hundred Demons[/h3]
Apart from the regular dungeon drops, every 3 days the mode switches to the "Night Parade of One Hundred Demons". In this mode, the dropped treasures are more unique and rare. In our next major update (v0.7), we will further refine this mode, adding more random BUFFs and DEBUFFs to challenge players!

[h3]New Equipment System[/h3]
We've overhauled the equipment system. Now, dungeons will drop equipment for various parts, and these pieces will come with random features that enhance character traits. For instance, there might be a trait that boosts sword skills. This allows for greater character development freedom. Additionally, there's a set system where you can gather specific sets for powerful effects. Expect more equipment updates!

[h3]Character Development:[/h3]
Besides the original attributes, we've added more trait developments and skill specializations. You can now specialize in certain skill types. For instance, using a skill frequently can raise its level, leading to increased damage. Furthermore, you can mold your character to be a close-ranged life-drainer or a ranged glass cannon focusing on critical hits!

[h3]New Battle Maps and AI[/h3]
We've redesigned most of the battle scenes and UI. Now, you can automatically deploy your team and freely adjust your formations. By default, tanks are positioned at the front to block damage, while ranged units are at the back to deal damage. There are also destructible objects in battles. For example, destroying portals can reduce enemy spawns.

[h3]Diverse Event Gameplay[/h3]
Apart from combat and dialogues to progress through events, we've introduced mini-games to complete special events and obtain rare skills and equipment. We'll be adding similar mechanisms in the future to enrich the gameplay.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43307060/c4ba686d17e6f01c7e2d8ada7dc3ca963a7822e1.png[/img]

[h2]This update requires a fresh start![/h2]
This update enriches character development and modifies the underlying structure for future content expansions. Our next major version, V0.7, will introduce chapter reward systems and refine the Night Parade mode. It's expected to roll out soon. If you don't wish to start anew, you might want to skip this version and let the bullets fly for a while.

Lastly, we're recruiting internal testers to help provide feedback for our next update. If interested, please email us at Laozi@neoax.io. Thank you all!

(Note: Some cultural and game-specific terms, like "Night Parade of One Hundred Demons", might need contextual adjustments based on your target audience.)

notes.title: 0.65 RELEASED
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

After tireless work from the team, in this update, we have enhanced the sense of combat and optimized the sound effects of the moves. We will continue to update this part daily for better combat feedback. We've added a sword manual normal attack skill (defaulted to the left mouse button) that you can freely equip, but please note that currently this skill only works when a sword is equipped. We have also re-polished the storyline before Tongcheng Fuyun (Chapter 2). We hope everyone will continue to give us your invaluable feedback. Thank you!

New content:
[b]Lower area of the Ghost Realm[/b]: The Ghost Realm is the dwelling place of spirits. The opponents inside offer a completely different level of intensity than before!
[b]Fog area of the Death Tree Sea[/b]: Some have found demons hiding deep within the Death Tree Sea. We wonder if their low-key presence hides some sort of conspiracy?
[b]New disciple Ah Fei and his side story: Blade Devil Tianlang[/b]
Event Encounters: 5

BUG:
Fixed the issue where Chapter 4 could not be triggered.

We will open (Chapter 5) Beast Rampage and (Chapter 6) Life from Dead Ends in July, with more events and new demon, the Golden Monk, for players to challenge!

[b]Azure Dragon joins the battle![/b]

notes.title: 0.6 RELEASED！
notes.content:
Hello,

After tireless efforts by the team, the first version 0.6 of the Early Access is officially launched,

The content includes:
Main Chapters: (Chapter 1)  [b]Dancing of Dragons and Tigers[/b], (Chapter 2) [b]The Storm of Tongcheng[/b], (Chapter 3) [b]Blood Rain and Violent Wind[/b], (Chapter 4) [b]Evil Forces Invasion[/b]

[b]Bamboo Lake Forest: [/b]
A fox demon is causing trouble in your base, you are commissioned by travelers to ensure their safety
[b]Outer Ring of the Beast Mountain[/b] &[b]Inner Ring of the Beast Mountain [/b]:
Beast Mountain has always been a mixture of dragons and snakes since ancient times, can you subdue these beasts?
[b]Outer Ring of the Death Forest:[/b]
 A poisonous serpent appears in the forest outside the East Sea City, nearby residents request your help!
[b]Village of the Dead: [/b]
The villagers of this village have been transformed into zombies without their own thoughts by the evil path, go to relieve them and uncover the plot behind it!
[b](Evil) Dragon Tiger Mountain Stronghold:[/b] 
Can you sweep the bandits in Dragon Tiger Mountain in one fell swoop to expand your sphere of influence
[b](Evil) Sky Evil Sect: [/b]
The evil forces next to your territory are always looking for opportunities to overthrow your power, can you see through their plot and keep your sect?
[b](Righteous) Lingyun Pavilion:[/b] 
Look for all the forces that can form an alliance to resist the invasion of evil factions!
[b]Outer Ring of the Yellow Sand Zone:[/b] 
A group of beasts occupies the crystal mines in the desert, causing no growth in the surrounding land
[b]Yellowstone Cave: [/b]
A group of sand bandits are hiding deep in the desert, can you find them and solve the hidden dangers of the desert!
[b]Event Encounters: [/b]150!
[b]Learnable Skills: [/b]120!

There are several locations, enemies, and unexpected encounters in the game waiting for your adventure!

[h2][b] YOU CAN CHLLENGE ASURA NOW!! [/b][/h2]
